question: Which Indian institute developed a self-actuating drug delivery system for rheumatoid arthritis treatment?
solution:
The correct answer is __**INST Mohali.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Researchers from the Institute of Nano Science and Technology (INST) Mohali have developed a self-actuating drug delivery system for targeted **rheumatoid arthritis (RA) treatment**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The system uses **microspheres loaded with methotrexate**, releasing the drug only in inflamed joints.**
 
• It minimizes side effects, improves therapeutic outcomes, and reduces the need for frequent dosing.
 
• Uses **polymer-lipid hybrid micro-composites** for high drug encapsulation and enzyme-triggered release.
 
• Animal studies showed reduced **joint swelling, inflammation, and cartilage damage**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **AIIMS Delhi:**__ Premier medical institute conducting research on arthritis and autoimmune diseases.
 
• __**IIT Bombay:**__ Known for biomedical research and nanotechnology applications in healthcare.
 
• __**CSIR-CCMB (Centre for Cellular & Molecular Biology):**__ Focuses on genetic and molecular research in diseases.
